name: Sort tasks on KanBan
description: Sorts tasks after drag and drop on the KanBan.
whenToUse: Reorder tasks and set their KanBan status after a drag-and-drop; use to persist task ordering on the board, not to edit task content (mutating).

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes

fields.name: task_ids
fields.description: Array of task IDs to be sorted

fields.name: status_id
fields.description: Status ID to assign to sorted tasks

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: Array of task IDs in the desired sort order
